capabilities.description: Ask a named person a question. The turn settles; the answer arrives as context in a later turn. Never suspends a turn and never blocks the person from acting.

config.transport: host-owned; the question is a durable GaugeDesk record, not an outbound network effect
config.recipient: an AuthorityId resolved against the account roster; absent means the chat owner
config.answer: attributed to the authority that gave it

profiles.name: question-asker
profiles.description: Allow an agent to ask a named person a question.
